title: The Heavenly Secrets First Manifest
next_chapter_hook: At the instant that phantom vanished, Chen Ji felt the fragment in his chest convulse violently—that was a reaction the Tianji Record had never shown before, as if it had sensed something of paramount importance...

text.content:
Tianqing Sect, Servant Disciple Resting Quarters.

Chen Ji leaned against the cold stone wall, his chest heaving剧烈起伏. The异象 of the bloodline awakening just now was like a thunderclap, shattering a crack in the废物人设 he had painstakingly built.

The阴鸷 eyes of Fifth Elder Ling Yuan—he had seen them clearly—that was not mere suspicion, but a scrutinizing gaze带着某种预谋.

Chen Ji closed his eyes and concentrated, his mind racing. The bloodline awakening was an accident, but Ling Yuan's reaction was too extreme—he seemed to have been waiting for this opportunity.

"Thoroughly investigate the bloodline source,"呵, what a noble excuse. What he truly wanted to investigate was probably that thing on his person.

At that moment, the shadows in the corner of the resting room suddenly twisted.

Every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end, his hand already touching the talisman hidden in his sleeve. However, before he could act, a hoarse voice sounded beside his ear:

dialogue.content: No need to be nervous, young friend. If I had intended to take your life, that disturbance just now would have been the perfect opportunity.

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

He spun around, only to find a blurred gray figure had somehow appeared three steps away. The person was shrouded in black mist, his features indistinct, save for those eyes—深邃如渊, as if藏着无尽的岁月与秘密.

dialogue.content: Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is—" The person slightly tilted his head, "is that thing on your person still safe?

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart was shaken to its core.

That thing—he had never revealed the existence of the Tianji Record Fragment before anyone. How did this mysterious person know?

He suppressed his churning emotions, revealing nothing on his face, and said calmly:

dialogue.content: I don't know what you're talking about.

text.content:
The mysterious person let out a low laugh.

"Chen Xuan said the same thing back then." The voice seemed to come from antiquity, "Unfortunately, those chosen by the Tianji Record never get to choose for themselves."

Chen Xuan—that was his father's name!

Chen Ji's mask finally cracked. His fingers trembled slightly, and a suppressed pain and hatred flickered in his eyes.

"Who the hell are you?" His voice was hoarse like a beast's growl.

choice.prompt: The mysterious person seemed to know all the secrets of the Tianji Record and Chen Xuan. Chen Ji needed to judge whether this person was friend or foe...

choices.description: Since the other party掌握这么多信息, better to retreat while advancing, to试探对方真实意图
choices.visible_cost: Reveal the Existence of the Tianji Record Fragment

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly withdrew the fragment glowing with a faint light from his怀.

The mysterious person's figure trembled slightly, and those profound eyes actually flickered with an indescribable complex emotion—was it nostalgia, regret, or...guilt?

dialogue.content: Indeed...the Tianji Record Fragment. After all these years, it has finally reappeared.

choices.description: The other party knows too much, cannot be easily trusted. First试探对方底细与立场, then judge
choices.visible_cost: Expend Energy to Set Up Test
choices.visible_reward: See the Other Party's True Attitude

text.content:
A harmless smile curved Chen Ji's lips.

"Since the elder knows so much, surely you understand my current predicament." He shifted topics, "What does the elder suggest regarding Elder Ling Yuan's 'investigation'?"

dialogue.content: Oh? The young friend is testing me?" The mysterious person laughed lightly, "Interesting. But I advise you not to play these petty tricks before me—I can see every thought in your mind.

choices.description: Master Mo has guarded the Tianji Record for many years; this matter must be reported to him for a decision
choices.visible_cost: Reveal the Existence of Master Mo

text.content:
Chen Ji silently recited the incantation, his consciousness sinking into the first page of the Tianji Record.

A moment later, Master Mo's familiar aged voice rang in his mind: "What's the urgency?" Chen Ji quickly described the current situation.

dialogue.content: ...Him?" Master Mo's voice unusually paused for an instant, "This person you cannot offend, nor can you trust lightly. Remember, what he says may not be false—but it's definitely not the whole truth either."

text.content:
The mysterious person seemed indifferent to Chen Ji's reaction and continued on his own:

"That old fox Ling Yuan has far more than Tianqing Sect standing behind him." The black mist rippled slightly, "Chen Xuan's death...was merely a beginning."

dialogue.content: Do you think Ling Yuan has survived until now for no reason? The three major sects have let him monopolize Tianqing Sect for so many years...do you think it was because of his meager cultivation?

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly.

He had always thought Ling Yuan merely relied on his seniority and cultivation. Now it seemed there was something else going on.

"You're saying..."

dialogue.content: I'm saying," the mysterious person's voice suddenly dropped low, "that behind Ling Yuan there is a hand manipulating things that you cannot yet see. And your father, back then, precisely because he discovered the true face of that hand..."

text.content:
Before he could finish, the mysterious person suddenly stopped.

He seemed to sense something. That blurred figure abruptly turned toward the door, his voice becoming urgent:

"Someone is coming. Take this—"

An ancient jade slip appeared in Chen Ji's hand out of thin air.

The moment it touched his palm, a familiar and heart-striking气息 gushed forth from the jade slip, rushing straight to Chen Ji's crown. That aura—with the Tianji Record Fragment, and with his father's lingering presence in memory...was completely identical!

Chen Ji shuddered violently.

He raised his head sharply, staring fixedly at the mysterious person's figure, his voice trembling: "This aura...you and my father...what exactly is the relationship?!"

dialogue.content:
The mysterious person's figure had begun to fade.

Before the black mist completely disappeared, a voice that made Chen Ji's very soul tremble entered his ears:

text.content:
"Your father...is still alive."

The words fell, and the mysterious person had vanished as if he had never existed. Only the jade slip in his palm still carried a faint warmth, and that lingering, father-like scent of the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji stood frozen, as if struck by lightning.

Father...is still alive? That father who had "accidentally died" when he was young, whose death the sect had hastily attributed to cultivation deviation...was actually still alive?!

Thirteen years of endurance,布局, scheming—all built on the foundation of his father being dead. Now this earth-shaking truth shattered the chess game he had painstakingly constructed...

choice.prompt: The news that his father was still alive plunged Chen Ji into unprecedented shock and confusion...

choices.description: That aura cannot be faked; Father must still be somewhere! There must be clues in this jade slip!

text.content:
Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, his knuckles white from用力.

Thirteen years. For thirteen years he had believed his father had long turned to dust, waking from nightmares countless nights, all dreams featuring those unwilling eyes of his father before death.

choices.description: This person's origins are unknown, the information volume is too great. Must first verify the jade slip's authenticity before making plans

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions.

The more earth-shaking the news, the more冷静对待 needed. What exactly was this mysterious person's purpose? Why appear at this moment?

dialogue.content: Even if the news is true...now is not the time to investigate. Ling Yuan's threat hasn't been resolved yet; cannot乱了阵脚.

choices.description: Regardless, first ask Master Mo to authenticate the jade slip's origins—this is the most urgent matter now

text.content:
Chen Ji hesitated no more, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record once more.

"Master Mo!" He presented the jade slip above the fragment, "Something this person left behind—please take a look..."

dialogue.content:
Master Mo was silent for a long time.

"This aura..." His voice became exceptionally grave, "is indeed Chen Xuan's. But the memories sealed within this jade slip...I cannot tell you yet. The time is not right."

text.content:
Just then, urgent footsteps came from outside the door.

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's cold voice pierced through the door, "The Fifth Elder wants to see you. Come with me!"

Chen Ji quickly gathered his thoughts and hid the jade slip in his怀. The thrilling conversation just now felt like merely a dream. But he knew, everything had changed.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao pushed open the door and entered, her sharp gaze sweeping over Chen Ji's entire body.

"Your aura..." Her brow furrowed slightly, "what happened?"

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his head, revealing a simple and timid smile.

"N-nothing." He lowered his head, "Perhaps it's the aftereffect of the bloodline awakening earlier—still a bit dizzy...Senior Sister Su, did I cause big trouble?"

Su Qingyao looked at him deeply.

That gaze carried scrutiny, but also a trace of worry she herself hadn't noticed. This废物 junior brother...seemed to have more and more mysteries surrounding him.

"Let's go." She turned, "Whatever the matter, we'll clarify it face to face."

Chen Ji lowered his head in assent and followed behind Su Qingyao.

As they passed through the corridor, his gaze inadvertently swept across the horizon. The mysterious person had said that behind Ling Yuan there was an invisible hand...what exactly was the true face of that hand?

And Father—that figure already blurred in his memory—why would he "return from the dead"?

All the mysteries pointed in the same direction.

At the instant that phantom vanished, Chen Ji felt the fragment in his chest convulse violently—that was a reaction the Tianji Record had never shown before, as if it had sensed something of paramount importance...

The jade slip in his怀 grew slightly warm, that familiar aura seeming to call out to something. Chen Ji's fingers unconsciously tightened, his knuckles white.

Thirteen years of layout, thirteen years of endurance.

If Father truly is still alive, then everything he has done all these years...must it all be rebuilt from scratch?
